<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Nasty Impala 89</title>
<style>
/* Nasty Impala 89 by anniekoop — https://uiverse.io/anniekoop/nasty-impala-89 */
.input {
  font-family: "SF Pro";
  max-width: 190px;
  padding: 0.875rem;
  font-size: 1rem;
  border: 1.5px solid #000;
  border-radius: 0.5rem;
  box-shadow: 2.5px 3px 0 #000;
  outline: none;
  transition: ease 0.25s;
}

.input:focus {
  box-shadow: 5.5px 7px 0 black;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<input placeholder="Email address" class="input" name="text" type="email" />

</body>
</html>
